title: Fill Period Used to Spread a Maximizer Benefit, Specialty Pharmacy Program Dispensing Table
content:
**Rule.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, the fill period used to spread a maximizer benefit is set as follows:

- When the latest fill was for more than 30 days, the fill period is that fill's days supply.
- When the drug is on the program's list of drugs filled for up to 90 days and the latest fill was for 30 days or fewer, the fill period is 90 days.
- Otherwise it is 30 days.

The latest fill is the enrollment's shipped fill with the latest ship date. Its days supply is the one booked on the shipment.

## The program's list of drugs filled for up to 90 days

| Tier | Drugs on the list |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Specialty Open Access | none |
| Northbridge Specialty Preferred | none |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive | none |
| Northbridge Specialty Exclusive with Copay Assist | none |
| Northbridge Specialty Care Management | none |
| Northbridge Specialty Total Care | Biktarvy |

## Ladder with both sides of the 30-day line (assumed fills on Northbridge Specialty Total Care)

| Drug | Latest fill's days supply | More than 30 days? | On the 90-day list? | Fill period |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Biktarvy | 90 | Yes | Yes | 90 days, the fill's own supply |
| Biktarvy | 31 | Yes | Yes | 31 days, the fill's own supply |
| Biktarvy | 30 | No | Yes | 90 days |
| Dupixent | 28 | No | No | 30 days |
| Humira | 30 | No | No | 30 days |
